# Pull Request

## Problem And Result

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.
Link the issue and add a closing reference only when its acceptance criteria are satisfied.

## Scope

Describe the changed components and material exclusions.

## Verification

List commands, outcomes, and the scope of reused passing evidence.

## Limitations And Follow-ups

Record failed or unrun checks and remaining limitations.
Link separate issues for new requirements or deferred findings.

## Review Checklist

- [ ] I preserved unrelated work, authority boundaries, and required behavior.
- [ ] I checked sentence-per-line prose, paragraph spacing, and filename references.
- [ ] I included commit bodies explaining reasons, changes, verification, and limitations.
- [ ] I excluded credentials and private environment details from the published change.
